purpose: Week 6: transfer learning (ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18) on named images, 4 classes
test: four rounds, each holding out one whole speed (4 runs, one per gear condition); 16 run-level predictions

settings.model: ResNet18, ImageNet weights, all layers fine-tuned
settings.epoch_selection: one training recording per class held out for validation; best validation macro F1
settings.augmentation: random horizontal flip, shift up to 8 px, brightness/contrast x0.8-1.2, Gaussian noise 0.05

selection_rule: the test set is never used to choose epochs or settings
